# MindeesUI

> A React Native + Expo UI library whose components read your JSX structure and apply smart, predictable layout defaults — the deterministic Layout Intelligence Layer. ~145 accessible components, 74 ready-made screen blocks (@mindees/blocks), and one-line brand theming. New Architecture only (Fabric + JSI + TurboModules + Bridgeless). iOS, Android, React Native Web. TypeScript strict, WCAG-conscious, Reanimated v4 UI-thread animations, Unistyles v3 (Nitro) theming. Tuned for low-end Android. Positioning: "components that understand layout context" — write less layout code, ship beautiful screens faster, override anything.

## Components (~145, package @mindees/ui)

### Layout & Typography
- `Box`, `Stack`, `HStack`, `VStack`, `ZStack`, `Grid`, `Divider`, `Spacer`, `SafeAreaView`, `ScreenWrapper`
- `Text`, `Heading`, `Subheading`, `Paragraph`, `Caption`, `Label`, `HelperText`, `ErrorText`, `Link`, `Code`, `Kbd`, `QuoteBlock`, `Mark`, `TruncatedText`, `ReadMore`, `RichText`

### Forms & Inputs
- `FormField`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `PasswordInput`, `SearchInput`, `EmailInput`, `PhoneInput`, `NumberInput`, `CurrencyInput`, `OTPInput`, `PINInput`
- `Select`, `MultiSelect`, `Autocomplete`, `TagInput`, `Checkbox`, `CheckboxGroup`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `Slider`, `RangeSlider`
- `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `TimePicker`, `FilePicker`, `ImagePicker`

### Buttons & Actions
- `Button`, `IconButton`, `FAB`, `ButtonGroup`, `SplitButton`, `ToggleButton`, `CloseButton`, `CopyButton`, `ShareButton`, `DownloadButton`, `UploadButton`, `RetryButton`, `BackButton`

### Overlays
- `Modal`, `Dialog`, `ConfirmationDialog`, `BottomSheet`, `Drawer`, `SidePanel`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `HoverCard`, `Toast`, `Snackbar`, `Banner`, `Notification`, `Alert`, `ActionSheet`, `DropdownMenu`, `ContextMenu`, `MegaMenu`, `Lightbox`, `FullscreenOverlay`, `CommandPalette`

### Navigation
- `Tabs`, `PillTabBar`, `BottomNavigation`, `TopBar`, `Breadcrumb`, `Pagination`, `Stepper`, `UserMenu`, `SettingsMenu`, `GlobalSearch`

### Display & Data
- `Card`, `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`, `Badge`, `Tag`, `Chip`, `Pill`, `Image`, `List`, `ListItem`, `Accordion`, `Progress`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `Stat`, `KPICard`, `Rating`, `Timeline`
- `Table`, `DataGrid`, `Feed`, `ActivityLog`, `DetailView`, `KeyValueRow`, `DescriptionList`, `Carousel`, `ImageGallery`, `TreeView`, `Calendar`

### States
- `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`, `OfflineState`, `MaintenanceState`, `LoadingState`, `SuccessState`, `WarningState`, `InfoState`

### Media (gated optional peers, graceful MissingPeer fallback)
- `ResponsiveImage`, `ImagePreview`, `FilePreview`, `Logo` (zero-dep)
- `VideoPlayer`, `AudioPlayer`, `PDFViewer`, `QRScanner`, `BarcodeScanner`, `LottieView`
- `CodeBlock`, `ColorPicker`, `QRCode`, `Barcode`, `Camera`, `MapView`, `SignaturePad`, `WebView`

### Mobile gestures
- `SwipeActions`, `SwipeableCard`, `PullToRefresh`, `InfiniteScroll`

## Blocks (74, package @mindees/blocks)

Pre-built screen compositions; pure UI, props-driven, restyle with tokens.
- Auth: `LoginForm`, `SignupForm`, `ForgotPasswordForm`, `ResetPasswordForm`, `OTPVerification`, `SocialLoginButtons`, `LogoutConfirmation`, `SessionExpiredModal`
- Commerce: `ProductCard`, `ProductGrid`, `ProductDetails`, `PriceDisplay`, `CartItem`, `CartSummary`, `CheckoutForm`, `AddressForm`, `OrderSummary`, `OrderStatus`, `CouponInput`, `ReviewsList`, `AddToCartButton`, `DiscountBadge`
- Account: `ProfileCard`, `ProfileEditor`, `AvatarUploader`, `AccountSettings`, `PrivacySettings`, `SecuritySettings`, `PasswordChangeForm`, `SubscriptionCard`, `BillingDetails`, `PaymentMethods`, `InvoiceList`, `DeleteAccountFlow`
- Social: `ChatList`, `ChatBubble`, `MessageComposer`, `VoiceMessage`, `TypingIndicator`, `ReadReceipt`, `NotificationItem`, `CommentBox`, `CommentsList`, `LikeButton`, `ReactionButton`, `FollowButton`, `ReportContentModal`
- Dashboard/Admin: `AnalyticsCards`, `AuditLog`, `RoleSelector`, `PermissionMatrix`, `SystemStatusPanel`, `Filters`, `SortControl`, `BulkActions`, `UserManagementTable`, `AdminLayout`
- Web: `CookieBanner`, `ResponsiveNavbar`, `WebFooter`, `PWAInstallPrompt`
- Screens: `HomeScreen`, `DashboardScreen`, `DetailsScreen`, `SettingsScreen`, `ProfileScreen`, `NotificationsScreen`, `SearchResultsScreen`, `OnboardingScreen`, `WalkthroughScreens`, `HelpScreen`, `NotFoundScreen`, `UnauthorizedScreen`, `NoInternetScreen`, `PricingScreen`
